criteria.title: Complete capability disposition
criteria.model: Complete capability disposition. Record a test-backed disposition for shell/SSH/interpreters, jobs/PTY, script orchestration/kernels, reads/list/search/LSP, edit/write/patch/notebook, HTTP/search/browser/computer, delegation, schedules/monitors/wakes, tasks/plans/goals, memory/checkpoint/resume/rewind, questions/approvals, images/artifacts/skills/discovery and pure TUI presentation. Each is managed execution, managed-backed native interface, deliberately retained interface with explicit boundary, or a precise unsupported gap. Discovery-only hiding is not security.
criteria.bar: Complete capability disposition. Record a test-backed disposition for shell/SSH/interpreters, jobs/PTY, script orchestration/kernels, reads/list/search/LSP, edit/write/patch/notebook, HTTP/search/browser/computer, delegation, schedules/monitors/wakes, tasks/plans/goals, memory/checkpoint/resume/rewind, questions/approvals, images/artifacts/skills/discovery and pure TUI presentation. Each is managed execution, managed-backed native interface, deliberately retained interface with explicit boundary, or a precise unsupported gap. Discovery-only hiding is not security.
criteria.method: METHOD (tree plane). Derive the capability surface from its own declaration rather than a hand-written list, then assert every enumerated surface carries exactly one recorded disposition drawn from the four permitted kinds: managed execution, managed-backed native interface, deliberately retained interface with an explicit stated boundary, or a precisely scoped unsupported gap. PROCEDURE: (1) read the capability taxonomy and MANAGED_CAPABILITY_RESTRICTIONS from the tree; (2) assert the dispositioned set EQUALS the enumerated set, so a silently dropped or newly added surface FAILS rather than reading as covered; (3) assert each disposition states its boundary or its gap in text, because discovery-only hiding is explicitly not a disposition and must not satisfy this bar; (4) pair every negative with a named calibration case the real taxonomy passes, so the controls cannot pass vacuously. FALSIFIED WHEN: any surface is undispositioned; a disposition is discovery-only concealment presented as security; a disposition names a kind but no boundary or gap; or the enumeration is hand-authored and therefore structurally unable to detect a taxonomy change.

criteria.title: Preserve command continuity
criteria.model: Preserve command continuity. Start each command once. Fast completion returns terminal output; exceeding the response window returns the SAME durable running job and full-output reference before MCP expiry without killing/restarting it. Separate execution deadline, response deadline, abort and explicit kill. Preserve exit truth and whole-tree cleanup, no double execution or orphaning. Completion remains observable through carry/restart.
criteria.bar: Preserve command continuity. Start each command once. Fast completion returns terminal output; exceeding the response window returns the SAME durable running job and full-output reference before MCP expiry without killing/restarting it. Separate execution deadline, response deadline, abort and explicit kill. Preserve exit truth and whole-tree cleanup, no double execution or orphaning. Completion remains observable through carry/restart.
criteria.method: METHOD (live plane). Drive real commands through the running managed path and measure continuity rather than inspecting code. PROCEDURE: (1) START-ONCE — run a command that writes a monotonic side effect (append a line per invocation) and assert exactly one write, so a retry or re-dispatch that restarts the command is detected rather than assumed absent; (2) FAST PATH — a command completing inside the response window returns its terminal output directly; (3) SLOW PATH — a command exceeding the response window returns, BEFORE MCP expiry, the SAME durable job identity and a full-output reference, and the underlying process is still alive afterwards (assert liveness by pid, not by the absence of an error); (4) DEADLINE SEPARATION — show execution deadline, response deadline, abort and explicit kill are four distinct controls by exercising each and asserting the other three did not fire; (5) EXIT TRUTH — a non-zero exit and a signal death are reported as themselves, not flattened; (6) CLEANUP — after kill, assert the whole process TREE is gone via cgroup membership, not by a name or pattern match; (7) CARRY — complete a job across a carry/restart boundary and assert completion is still observable afterwards. Each negative is paired with a calibration case the real path passes. FALSIFIED WHEN: a command runs twice, a slow command is killed or restarted to satisfy the response window, output is unreachable after the window, exit truth is flattened, a descendant survives cleanup, or completion becomes unobservable across restart.

criteria.title: Bounded context, recoverable permitted output
criteria.model: Bounded context, recoverable permitted output. Preserve complete permitted output outside context with useful bounded previews, exact range/tail/filter retrieval and truthful truncation/retention/write-failure metadata. Preserve Unicode; specify streams and binary capture rather than falsely promise byte equivalence. Credentials stay redacted/access-controlled. Preload essential tools, avoid repeated discovery and measure context bytes separately from RPC counts; exclude native bytes from managed-output claims.
criteria.bar: Bounded context, recoverable permitted output. Preserve complete permitted output outside context with useful bounded previews, exact range/tail/filter retrieval and truthful truncation/retention/write-failure metadata. Preserve Unicode; specify streams and binary capture rather than falsely promise byte equivalence. Credentials stay redacted/access-controlled. Preload essential tools, avoid repeated discovery and measure context bytes separately from RPC counts; exclude native bytes from managed-output claims.
criteria.method: METHOD (live plane). Measure what actually reaches context versus what remains retrievable, with real byte counts rather than claims. PROCEDURE: (1) produce a command whose output greatly exceeds the context budget and assert the COMPLETE permitted output is retrievable out-of-band while only a bounded preview enters context; (2) assert exact RANGE, TAIL and FILTER retrieval each return the bytes actually requested, verified against an independently computed expectation (a hash or a known generator), not against the tool's own echo; (3) assert truncation, retention and write-failure metadata are TRUTHFUL by forcing each condition — a truncated read must report truncated, a failed write must report failure rather than silently succeeding; (4) UNICODE — round-trip multi-byte and combining sequences and assert preservation; do not claim byte equivalence for streams where it is not offered: assert instead that stdout/stderr separation and binary capture are SPECIFIED and behave as specified; (5) CREDENTIALS — seed a known secret pattern in output and assert it is redacted or access-controlled at the retrieval boundary; (6) DISCOVERY COST — assert essential tools are preloaded and that repeated discovery does not recur, measuring CONTEXT BYTES separately from RPC counts and EXCLUDING native bytes from any managed-output claim. Every negative is paired with a calibration case the real path passes. FALSIFIED WHEN: permitted output is lost rather than externalized, a retrieval returns bytes other than those requested, truncation or write failure is under-reported, Unicode is corrupted, a secret reaches an unprotected reader, or a managed-output number silently includes native bytes.

criteria.title: PTY and script replacement quality
criteria.model: PTY and script replacement quality. Support managed PTY input, resize, incremental output, exit/cancel/cleanup, and reattachment or explicit unrecoverable restart outcomes. Preserve script authorized nested calls, branching/fan-out, cancellation, truthful uncertain writes, required explicit kernel state and media. Never silently replace persistent/multimodal workflows with stateless/text-only ones. Complete normal completion-wake behavior through existing events/task ownership.
criteria.bar: PTY and script replacement quality. Support managed PTY input, resize, incremental output, exit/cancel/cleanup, and reattachment or explicit unrecoverable restart outcomes. Preserve script authorized nested calls, branching/fan-out, cancellation, truthful uncertain writes, required explicit kernel state and media. Never silently replace persistent/multimodal workflows with stateless/text-only ones. Complete normal completion-wake behavior through existing events/task ownership.
criteria.method: METHOD (live plane). Exercise a REAL pty and a REAL multi-step script, asserting the interactive and stateful properties that a stateless text shim would silently lose. PROCEDURE — PTY: (1) send input to a live pty and assert the program observes it; (2) RESIZE and assert the program sees the new dimensions (run something that reports its own width); (3) assert output arrives INCREMENTALLY, by observing a partial read before the process exits rather than only the final buffer; (4) exercise exit, cancel and cleanup as distinct outcomes; (5) reattach to a surviving pty and assert continuity, OR assert an EXPLICIT unrecoverable-restart outcome — an ambiguous or silent loss fails. PROCEDURE — SCRIPT: (6) assert an authorized NESTED call from inside a script is permitted and attributed; (7) exercise branching and fan-out and assert each branch ran; (8) cancel mid-script and assert partial writes are reported as UNCERTAIN rather than as success or failure; (9) where kernel state is required, assert it is explicitly required and preserved across steps; (10) assert media/multimodal results survive as media rather than being degraded to text. (11) Assert normal completion-wake behavior flows through the EXISTING event and task-ownership surfaces rather than a parallel mechanism. Each negative carries a calibration case the real path passes. FALSIFIED WHEN: a persistent or multimodal workflow is silently replaced by a stateless or text-only one, resize/input/incremental output is unobserved, reattachment neither works nor reports an explicit unrecoverable outcome, an uncertain write is reported as certain, or completion-wake is re-implemented outside the existing events.

criteria.title: Documented recovery exclusion
criteria.model: Documented recovery exclusion. No locally authorized native recovery path ships; the software-rooted substitute proven forgeable in D-007/D-008 is absent and unreachable, not merely unbuilt. Canonical documentation records the absence as a deliberate owner-directed exclusion citing D-010, so a reader cannot mistake it for an oversight and rebuild it. Capability gaps whose only closure route was the dropped path carry an explicit unsupported/documented-exclusion disposition rather than an open gap, with no implementation item stripped to reach zero. Resurrection under a weaker authority root is out of scope.
criteria.bar: Documented recovery exclusion. No locally authorized native recovery path ships; the software-rooted substitute proven forgeable in D-007/D-008 is absent and unreachable, not merely unbuilt. Canonical documentation records the absence as a deliberate owner-directed exclusion citing D-010, so a reader cannot mistake it for an oversight and rebuild it. Capability gaps whose only closure route was the dropped path carry an explicit unsupported/documented-exclusion disposition rather than an open gap, with no implementation item stripped to reach zero. Resurrection under a weaker authority root is out of scope.
criteria.method: METHOD (live plane). Prove the ABSENCE is real, unreachable and documented — never merely unbuilt. An absence claim requires a positive control. PROCEDURE: (1) ABSENCE — search the shipped surface for any locally-authorized / offline recovery authorization path (the software-rooted substitute D-007/D-008 proved forgeable) and assert zero live call sites; run the identical search for a token KNOWN to be present as a POSITIVE CONTROL and fail the measurement if the control also returns empty, since a broken instrument reports absence identically to a real absence. (2) UNREACHABLE, NOT MERELY UNBUILT — assert no route reaches it: no flag, env var, config key or tool argument enables it; attempt the capability through the RUNNING managed path and assert an explicit refusal rather than a silent no-op. (3) DOCUMENTED — assert canonical shipped documentation records the absence as a deliberate owner-directed exclusion CITING D-010 by id, and that the citation resolves to that decision rather than being free prose. (4) DISPOSITION — assert every capability gap whose only closure route was the dropped path carries an explicit unsupported/documented-exclusion disposition, and that no implementation item was stripped or deleted to reach zero open gaps. (5) NO RESURRECTION — assert no weaker authority root re-enables it. CHECK-FILE DISCLOSURE: this bar's `check` (managed-capability-matrix-real-client.integration.test.ts) is barHash material and was therefore NOT amendable when the model was re-authored under D-016; it is INHERITED from the pre-D-010 model and is NOT the falsifier for this bar. The falsifier is the documented-exclusion evidence named above. FALSIFIED WHEN: any live call site or reachable route to a locally-authorized recovery path exists; the exclusion is undocumented, uncited, or reads as an oversight rather than a decision; a gap only the dropped path could close is left open or was deleted rather than dispositioned; or the absence measurement has no passing positive control.

criteria.title: Enforced policy across clients and lifecycle
criteria.model: Enforced policy across clients and lifecycle. Claude/Codex/OMP managed launch, resume and wake use one policy with version-validated adapters. Cover aliases, shell/interpreter/script nesting, file/network/computer paths and override arguments. Preserve sandbox/credentials/network controls; a managed tool name does not confer confinement. Unknown controls or unproven removal produce explicit unsupported/denied truth, never a false managed guarantee.
criteria.bar: Enforced policy across clients and lifecycle. Claude/Codex/OMP managed launch, resume and wake use one policy with version-validated adapters. Cover aliases, shell/interpreter/script nesting, file/network/computer paths and override arguments. Preserve sandbox/credentials/network controls; a managed tool name does not confer confinement. Unknown controls or unproven removal produce explicit unsupported/denied truth, never a false managed guarantee.
criteria.method: METHOD (live plane). Assert ONE policy decision function governs every client and every lifecycle surface, and that unprovable confinement is reported as unsupported rather than guaranteed. PROCEDURE: (1) MATRIX — for each of Claude, Codex and OMP, and each of launch, resume and wake, assert the effective restriction is produced by the same policy resolver (assert identity of the decision path, not merely equal outcomes, so two divergent implementations that happen to agree today cannot pass); (2) ADAPTER VERSION — assert each adapter validates the client version it is rendering for, and that an unrecognized version yields an explicit unsupported/denied result rather than a silent best-effort render; drive this from a version READ FROM the installed client, not a fixture; (3) BYPASS PATHS — attempt denial evasion through each nesting route in turn: an ALIAS of the denied tool, a SHELL invocation, an INTERPRETER one-liner, a SCRIPT that calls out, a FILE path, a NETWORK path, a COMPUTER/GUI path, and an OVERRIDE ARGUMENT that re-enables the surface; assert each is denied, and pair with a calibration case that is correctly ALLOWED so the test cannot pass by denying everything; (4) CONFINEMENT TRUTH — assert sandbox, credential and network controls remain in force, and that a merely MANAGED TOOL NAME is never accepted as evidence of confinement; (5) UNKNOWN CONTROLS — assert an unknown or unremovable control produces explicit unsupported/denied truth. FALSIFIED WHEN: any client/surface bypasses the shared resolver, a bypass route succeeds, an unversioned adapter renders silently, or a managed name is treated as a confinement guarantee.

criteria.title: Preserve UX and correct canonical state
criteria.model: Preserve UX and correct canonical state. Keep native rendering/navigation/diffs/images/skills/discovery and useful plan/question panels when their operations use managed authority. Distinguish session tasks from shared work/plans/goals, durable memory from scratch context, transcript resume from filesystem rewind, HTTP fetch from browser/search, and exact-string edit from multi-file patch. Retained reads/provider/media paths have explicit access/output policies or honestly stated exclusions.
criteria.bar: Preserve UX and correct canonical state. Keep native rendering/navigation/diffs/images/skills/discovery and useful plan/question panels when their operations use managed authority. Distinguish session tasks from shared work/plans/goals, durable memory from scratch context, transcript resume from filesystem rewind, HTTP fetch from browser/search, and exact-string edit from multi-file patch. Retained reads/provider/media paths have explicit access/output policies or honestly stated exclusions.
criteria.method: METHOD (live plane). Verify the preserved surface still RENDERS and that the durable-versus-ephemeral distinctions are enforced by behavior, not by naming. PROCEDURE — UX: (1) drive the real client and assert native rendering, navigation, diffs, images, skills and discovery still work while their underlying operations run on managed authority; assert the plan and question panels remain useful (they render and accept input), rather than asserting only that the surface exists. PROCEDURE — DISTINCTIONS, each proven by a behavioral consequence, not a label: (2) SESSION TASK vs SHARED WORK — a session task must NOT appear as shared work to a peer, and shared work MUST survive the session ending; (3) DURABLE MEMORY vs SCRATCH CONTEXT — durable memory survives a context reset, scratch does not; assert both directions; (4) TRANSCRIPT RESUME vs FILESYSTEM REWIND — resume restores conversation without reverting files; rewind reverts files; assert each leaves the OTHER untouched; (5) HTTP FETCH vs BROWSER/SEARCH — assert a fetch does not execute page scripts while the browser path does; (6) EXACT-STRING EDIT vs MULTI-FILE PATCH — assert the edit refuses a non-unique match while the patch applies across files. (7) RETAINED PATHS — for every retained read/provider/media path, assert an explicit access and output policy is stated and enforced, or that its exclusion is stated honestly; an undocumented retained path fails. Each negative carries a calibration case the real path passes. FALSIFIED WHEN: a preserved surface stops rendering, any two distinctions above collapse behaviorally, or a retained path has neither an enforced policy nor an honest stated exclusion.
criteria.driftMarkers: R-7 is falsified when the required outcome is absent, contradicted, or cannot be evidenced on the live plane.

criteria.title: Evidence-gated cutover and actual shipment
criteria.model: Evidence-gated cutover and actual shipment. Activate each restriction only after replacement, offline recovery and per-client launch/resume/wake acceptance pass with positive/negative controls. Test version drift, output recovery, jobs/PTY, cancellation, scripts/media, sandbox and nested bypass paths. Canary/rollback reuse existing config and telemetry. Finish code-truth audit, post-implementation rubric/vetting, independent eligible non-lineage grading, author acceptance, deployed-control verification and shipped plan status. Do not silently drop unmet outcomes.
criteria.bar: Evidence-gated cutover and actual shipment. Activate each restriction only after replacement, offline recovery and per-client launch/resume/wake acceptance pass with positive/negative controls. Test version drift, output recovery, jobs/PTY, cancellation, scripts/media, sandbox and nested bypass paths. Canary/rollback reuse existing config and telemetry. Finish code-truth audit, post-implementation rubric/vetting, independent eligible non-lineage grading, author acceptance, deployed-control verification and shipped plan status. Do not silently drop unmet outcomes.
criteria.method: METHOD (deployed plane). Verify the cutover was EVIDENCE-GATED rather than merely intended, and that the plan actually shipped on the deployed build. PROCEDURE: (1) GATING ORDER — for each activated restriction, assert its activation is CONDITIONED on its replacement, offline-recovery and per-client launch/resume/wake acceptance having passed; prove the condition by exhibiting the withheld case: with an acceptance result missing, failing, stale or recorded against a different client version, the default must NOT activate, and with all present it must; a passing suite alone is not evidence of gating; (2) CONTROLS — every case above carries both a positive and a negative control, and each negative is paired with a named calibration case, so a permanently-denying or permanently-allowing implementation fails; (3) DRIFT — exercise version drift, output recovery, jobs/PTY, cancellation, scripts/media, sandbox and nested bypass, each as its own case; (4) CANARY/ROLLBACK — assert these REUSE the existing config and telemetry surfaces rather than introducing a parallel mechanism, and that rollback actually restores the prior posture; (5) DEPLOYED TRUTH — verify the controls on the DEPLOYED build, identified by its health sha, not on the working tree or a local test run; a tree-plane pass does not satisfy this bar; (6) CEREMONY — assert the code-truth audit, post-implementation rubric authoring, vetting, independent non-lineage grading, author acceptance and shipped plan status are each complete and recorded.
